worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.summary: Crushes all of the user's psychic power into one point; rings of psychic force close in and implode on the target for the heaviest hit of the family. After the cast the user's Sp. Atk drops harshly. The echo form adds a second implosion at the impact point, at the cost of a slightly weaker first hit and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.use.0: Long-range nuke with the heaviest hit of the family
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.use.1: Telegraph a remote implosion with closing psychic rings
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.use.2: Echo form: add a second implosion at the impact point
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.descriptio: The psychic rings collide for %1$s special damage to the target.
The psychic rings close in on the target over %1$s s and burst for a radius of %2$s blocks.
Range %1$s blocks; there is no projectile, the force reaches the target directly.
After one implosion the user's Sp. Atk drops %1$s stage(s), hit or miss.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.echo.on: Echo form: the first hit is x0.86; %2$s s later a second implosion at the impact point deals %1$s power to foes within %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.echo.off: Instant form: one all-out hit, resolved on the spot, heavier and faster, but only one implosion.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.growth.0: From level %1$s the implosion power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.growth.1: From level %1$s the implosion power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.psychoboost.preference: On: the first hit is x0.86, but a second implosion at the impact point follows for extra damage; wind-up +3 ticks, cooldown +7 ticks, and the target can walk out of range to dodge the echo. Off (instant): one all-out hit, resolved on the spot, heavier and faster.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts the implosion from farther away.
On: the target with the highest health ratio ranks first, so the heaviest hit goes to the toughest foe; off: all targets score the same.
